reuse.why: Reuses the shared link-precondition helper in link.ts for all six providers, but re-writes the unlink field-clearing update instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block that clears account_id, bank, balances, sync source and status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount (app.ts), so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: The flag is threaded through the shared LinkAccountBaseParams and decided once in link.ts, which is where the tree keeps link preconditions; mutating other accounts from a function that used to be an assertion is slightly surprising.

scope.why: Only the flag, its handling and tests are added; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Renaming the assertion to claimBankAccount and having it unlink holders before the new link is created mixes validation with side effects, and the copied clearing block will drift from unlinkAccount if the unlinked state ever gains a field.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts claimBankAccount clears the holder with its own db.updateAccount instead of sharing the local part of unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied clearing block in link.ts is a literal copy of unlinkAccount's update, not disguised.
